59857-the-evening-post-a-century-of-jour.title: The Evening Post A Century Of Journalism
59857-the-evening-post-a-century-of-jour.creator: Unknown
59857-the-evening-post-a-century-of-jour.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Of all the newspapers established as party organs in the time when Federalists and Democrats were struggling for control of the government of the infant republic, but one important journal survives. It is the oldest daily in the larger American cities which has kept its name intact.

69734-lysistrata.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. It has been a great pleasure for me to read _Lysistrata_—it is so stimulating. Whether one agrees with your views or not (and I disagree with many of them), the book impels one to re-examine one’s standards of value, and that is the highest function a book can perform.

arxiv-2211-02770.title: Query Processing at Snapchat: How we Handle Query Completion, Suggestion and Localization DOI: 10.1145/1122445.1122456 CCS: Information systems Query log analysis CCS: Information systems Query suggestion
arxiv-2211-02770.creator: Vasyl Pihur
arxiv-2211-02770.description: Abstract . Snapchat, a popular social media platform, started as a simple communication application. Over the years, however, it introduced Lenses and filters, Stories, Bitmoji, Stickers, Discover publishing content, Maps, Cameos and recently, Spotlight. With the ever increasing breadth of new engaging features came the need for an efficient and universal search platform.

arxiv-2401-09716.title: HCVP: Leveraging Hierarchical Contrastive Visual Prompt for Domain Generalization
arxiv-2401-09716.creator: Guanglin Zhou, Zhongyi Han, Shiming Chen, Biwei Huang, Liming Zhu, Tongliang Liu, Lina Yao, Kun Zhang
arxiv-2401-09716.description: Abstract Domain Generalization (DG) endeavors to create machine learning models that excel in unseen scenarios by learning invariant features. In DG, the prevalent practice of constraining models to a fixed structure or uniform parameterization to encapsulate invariant features can inadvertently blend specific aspects.

arxiv-2407-05754.title: Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces in Upper Mid-Band 6G Networks: Gain or Pain?
arxiv-2407-05754.creator: Ferdi Kara, Özlem Tuğfe Demir, Emil Björnson
arxiv-2407-05754.description: Abstract Reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RISs) have emerged as one of the most studied topics in recent years, hailed as a transformative technology with the potential to revolutionize future wireless systems. While RISs are recognized for their ability to enhance spectral efficiency, coverage, and the reliability of wireless channels, several challenges remain.

arxiv-2411-07700.title: Test Where Decisions Matter: Importance-driven Testing for Deep Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2411-07700.creator: Stefan Pranger, Hana Chockler, Martin Tappler, Bettina Könighofer
arxiv-2411-07700.description: Abstract In many Deep Reinforcement Learning (RL) problems, decisions in a trained policy vary in significance for the expected safety and performance of the policy. Since RL policies are very complex, testing efforts should concentrate on states in which the agent’s decisions have the highest impact on the expected outcome.

arxiv-2505-22659.title: A General Marked Point Process Framework For Self-Exciting Network Evolution
arxiv-2505-22659.creator: Duncan A. Clark, Department of Statistics, Williams College
arxiv-2505-22659.description: Abstract We propose a novel modeling framework for time-evolving networks allowing for long-term dependence in network features that update in continuous time. Dynamic network growth is functionally parameterized via the conditional intensity of a marked point process. This characterization enables flexible, joint modeling of both update timing and the network updates themselves, dependent on the entire left-continuous sample path.

arxiv-2508-12266.title: Bayesian Calibration of the Crossterms Eigenvolume HRG Model: Integrating Lattice QCD and Experimental Data
arxiv-2508-12266.creator: Nachiketa Sarkar
arxiv-2508-12266.description: Abstract We perform a Bayesian calibration of the Crossterms Eigenvolume Hadron Resonance Gas (Cross EV-HRG) model, which incorporates flavor-dependent repulsive interactions in a thermodynamically consistent framework. For the first time, the model is simultaneously constrained using lattice QCD (LQCD) thermodynamic observables and centrality-resolved hadron yield data from Pb–Pb collisions at s NN = 2.76 \sqrt{s_{\mathrm{NN}}}=2.

pmc-12566360.title: Nanofibrous Polymer Filters for Removal of Metal Oxide Nanoparticles from Industrial Processes
pmc-12566360.creator: Andrzej Krupa, Arkadiusz Tomasz Sobczyk, Anatol Jaworek, Alexander Toikka
pmc-12566360.description: Filtration of submicron particles and nanoparticles is an important problem in nano-industry and in air conditioning and ventilation systems. The presence of submicron particles comprising fungal spores, bacteria, viruses, microplastic, and tobacco-smoke tar in ambient air is a severe problem in air conditioning systems.

pmc-12719823.title: Epidemiology, pathophysiology, diagnosis and management of atrial functional mitral regurgitation: An expert opinion paper
pmc-12719823.creator: Matteo Pagnesi, Mauro Riccardi, Francesco Maisano, Julia Grapsa, Vassilis Barberis, Magdy Abdelhamid, Elena‐Laura Antohi, Henrike Arfsten, Nicole Karam, Denisa Muraru, Karl‐Philipp Rommel, Anna Sannino, Wilfried Mullens, Marianna Adamo, Marco Metra
pmc-12719823.description: Atrial functional mitral regurgitation (AFMR) is an increasingly recognized subtype of mitral regurgitation, characterized by left atrial remodelling and mitral annular dilation in the absence of primary mitral valve disease or left ventricular dysfunction. Closely linked to chronic atrial fibrillation and heart failure with preserved ejection fraction, AFMR is associated with poor clinical outcomes and represents a growing therapeutic challenge.

pmc-12856001.title: Recent advances in mechanistic studies and catalyst development for electrochemical nitrate reduction to ammonia
pmc-12856001.creator: Debasish Halder, Sujan Sen, Sounak Roy
pmc-12856001.description: Increasing nitrate (NO3−) concentration in water bodies due to anthropogenic activities has become a leading environmental challenge of the 21st century. Electrochemical nitrate reduction reaction (eNO3RR) offers a sustainable solution by simultaneously removing nitrates and producing ammonia, a valuable feedstock. However, eNO3RR possesses significant challenges, such as efficiency, competing reactions, product selectivity, catalyst stability, etc.

pmc-13188707.title: The relationship between compassionate love, burnout levels and caring behaviors of intensive care nurses: the mediating role of compassion fatigue
pmc-13188707.creator: Gülsün Özdemir Aydın, Halide Aksu, Nuray Turan, Eylem Toğluk Yiğitoğlu
pmc-13188707.description: BackgroundIntensive care nurses are frequently exposed to emotionally demanding environments that challenge their ability to sustain compassionate care. These stressors may compromise their emotional well-being, leading to compassion fatigue, burnout, and reduced quality of caring behaviors. This study aimed to examine the relationship between compassion fatigue, burnout, and caring behaviors among intensive care nurses.

pmc-13191114.title: The evolution of gene functional repertoire in Amorphea: divergent strategies across Amoebozoa, Fungi, and Metazoa
pmc-13191114.creator: Alex Gàlvez-Morante, Cédric Berney, Daniel J Richter
pmc-13191114.description: Metazoa and Fungi have been extensively studied to reconstruct the trajectory of Opisthokont evolution. Their sister group, Amoebozoa, provides additional potential to generate valuable insights into the origins of Opisthokont lineages. Amoebozoa represent a diverse group of amoeboid organisms, which have adapted to a wide range of environments and ecological niches.
